entities.name: Gan Shokta
entities.description: A formidable Gruul warrior on Ravnica and father of Araithia Shokta, fiercely loyal to his clan.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Daughter of Gan Shokta, whose concealment enchantment affects her father.

entities.name: Ari Shokta
entities.description: Rat's mother, who brings urgent news to Borborygmos and Gan.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker saved alongside Teyo and Araithia by Gan Shokta and the Gruul.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: An ally of Kaya who helps save Gan Shokta from an Eternal.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the Gruul and declared an alliance with Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon whose forces attack Ravnica.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: Leader of the Gruul guild whom Gan returns to.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon revived in a golden form by a ritual of the guild representatives.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A God-Eternal who attacks and is defeated by the revived Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of warriors Gan belongs to.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Undead soldiers of Nicol Bolas's army.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Gan Shokta lives.

entities.name: The Citadel
entities.description: Site of the battle against Nicol Bolas's forces.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war that Gan and his family survived.

events.summary: Gan Shokta and the Gruul arrive in time to save Kaya, Teyo and Araithia from the Eternals; Gan is nearly killed and saved by the trio.
events.quote: Gan Shokta was almost killed by an Eternal but was saved by the combined efforts of Teyo, Kaya, and Araithia.

events.summary: Gan denounces Domri after Domri declares an alliance with Nicol Bolas and leaves the group to return to Borborygmos.
events.quote: He then left Domri and the group, maintaining his integrity and commitment to his principles.

events.summary: Gan confronts Borborygmos over the guild's direction until Rat and Ari bring urgent news; Gan accepts the outsiders on seeing his daughter.
events.quote: Gan Shokta engaged in a conflict with him over the direction of the guild.

events.summary: A ritual revives Niv-Mizzet in a golden form, and he defeats God-Eternal Kefnet.
events.quote: The ritual successfully revived Niv-Mizzet in a new, golden form

events.summary: Gan and the others rush toward the Citadel to fight Nicol Bolas's forces.
events.quote: rushed toward the Citadel to continue their battle against Nicol Bolas's forces

events.summary: Gan and his family survive the War of the Spark and join the new Gruul Clan freed from Domri.
events.quote: Gan and his family survived the War of the Spark and were part of the new Gruul Clan, freed from Domri's leadership.

relations.quote: Gan Shokta is a Gruul warrior on the plane of Ravnica , and father of Araithia Shokta .
Gan Shokta is a Gruul warrior on the plane of Ravnica

relations.note: denounced him after his alliance with Bolas
relations.quote: Gan Shokta publicly denounced Domri, calling him a follower rather than a leader
